customManagers.description: The pinned upstream commit of DroppedNeedle's unreleased v3 branch (build/Dockerfile). Tracks the head of DROPPEDNEEDLE_REF as a git digest.

packageRules.description: A new upstream commit can carry migrations that a later build refuses to undo, and v3 still edits shipped migrations. It moves only on purpose: never automatic, only after approval in the dependency dashboard, with a database backup first (kubernetes/droppedneedle README, Updating).

The rust and node base images follow the pinned commit (its rust-toolchain.toml and upstream Dockerfile), not their own release cadence; the Dockerfile fails the build when rust and the toolchain file disagree. Only digest refreshes of the same tag are taken automatically.
